subTitle: #ETH  قال بيرت بافيت ذات مرة: إن المرء لا يحتاج في حياته إلا إلى فعل أمرين صحيحين فقط ليصبح شديد الثراء. فالكثيرون يُهزمون لا لأنهم غير مجتهدين، بل لأنهم يحبون أن يظلّوا منشغلين بالتدخل العشوائي بشكل متكرر؛ اليوم يطاردون “السوق الرائجة”، غدًا يغيّرون المسار، ويعاملون الاستثمار كأنه كازينو. يمكن لبافيت ومُنجر أن يقضيا سنواتٍ دون أن يشتريا شيئًا، مكتفيين بالجلوس بهدوء لقراءة الكتب والتفكير. والحقيقة أن حياتهما كلّها لم تُصب إلا في هذين الأمرين: أولًا، العثور على أعمالٍ قوية يمكنها الصمود أمام اختبار الزمن؛ وكلما كان هيكلها أبسط كان أفضل، والأفضل أن تكون حاجةً ضروريةً دائمًا، وأن تكون لها احتكارات، وأن ترتبط بقطاعات محورية تمسّ الاقتصاد الوطني ومعيشة الناس؛ لست بحاجة لأن تكون شديد الذكاء، كل ما تحتاجه هو درجة قصوى من اليقين. ثانيًا، بعد الشراء، التمسّك الشديد وعدم البيع؛ فالتعقيد (الفائدة المركبة) يحتاج وقتًا ليتخمّر وينضج—كما في عملية تخمير النبيذ: تفتح القارورة اليوم لتطّلع عليها، وتفتحها غدًا لتذوق… لكن لن تتمكن بعدها أبدًا من إنتاج نبيذٍ جيد. ومعظم الناس، عندما ترتفع الأسعار يريدون البيع، وعندما تنخفض يصابون بالذعر ويستعجلون القطع (البيع بخسارة)، يحدّقون في الشاشة يومًا بعد يوم، فيساهمون برسوم التداول عبثًا. أما أولئك الذين يكثرون من التداول في النهاية، فغالبًا ما يدفعون بسيارة فيراري إلى الداخل ثم يخرجون منها على دراجة هوائية. وفي هذا السوق، لا يكسب المال الكبير من تكون يده الأسرع ولا من يكون أكثر جنونًا، بل من يستطيع أن يجلس بهدوءٍ كصيادٍ متروٍ. إن الفارق الجوهري بين الغني والفقير لم يكن أبدًا فيمن هو أذكى، بل فيمن يستطيع أكثر أن يتحمّل؛ تقليل الأفعال غير الضرورية، والوقوف في المكان الصحيح، ثم انتظار انفجار أثر الفائدة المركبة!

translatedData.subTitle: #ETH  Bert Buffett once said: You only need to get two things right in life to become very wealthy. Many people fail not because they aren’t hardworking, but because they keep meddling randomly and staying busy: today they chase the “hot market,” tomorrow they change course, and they treat investing like a casino. Buffett and Munger could go years without buying anything, simply sitting quietly, reading books, and thinking. In fact, they got just these two things right throughout their lives. First, find strong businesses that can stand the test of time. The simpler their structure, the better; ideally, they should meet an enduring need, have monopolies, and be connected to core industries that affect the national economy and people’s livelihoods. You don’t need to be extremely smart; all you need is the highest possible degree of certainty. Second, once you’ve bought, hold on tight and don’t sell. Compounding needs time to ferment and mature—like making wine: open the bottle today to check on it, then open it tomorrow to taste it… and you’ll never be able to make good wine. Most people want to sell when prices rise, and panic and rush to cut their losses when prices fall. They stare at the screen day after day, wasting money on trading fees. Those who trade too much often end up driving a Ferrari in and riding a bicycle out. In this market, big money isn’t made by the quickest hand or the craziest person, but by those who can sit quietly, like patient anglers. The fundamental difference between the rich and the poor has never been who is smarter, but who can endure more: do less that’s unnecessary, stand in the right place, and wait for the power of compounding to explode!

一、以太坊市场走势分析

截至二零二六年十月五日下午五时，以太坊现货价格报二千六百九十九美元，过去二十四小时微涨百分之零点一七。价格盘中触及二千七百三十美元的日内高点后回落，最低探至二千六百七十九美元，整体维持在狭窄区间内震荡。最近五根小时K线呈现窄幅整理态势，成交量从第一根的四千三百六十五万美元大幅波动后，逐步回落至第八百零四万美元，市场处于明显的观望状态。

均线系统方面，七日移动平均线从二千七百一十六美元下行至二千七百零六美元，价格运行在短期均线下方。二十五日均线维持在二千七百一十四美元附近，九十九日均线在二千七百零一美元提供长期支撑。当前价格已跌破所有短期均线，但紧贴九十九日均线，该位置能否形成有效支撑是短线关键。布林带上轨二千七百三十六美元，中轨二千七百一十五美元，下轨二千六百九十四美元，价格在中轨与下轨之间运行，偏向弱势。

二、技术指标深度解读

RSI指标显示，六周期线从三十点七的低点回升至四十七点九，十二周期线从四十点零升至四十八点二，二十四周期线回升至五十点三，短期超卖修复较为明显。KDJ指标K值从三十一点三回升至四十三点六，D值从四十点六升至四十一点零，J值从十二点八大幅升至四十八点八，底部反弹信号较为明确。

MACD方面，DIF线从三点零八下行至负零点五三，DEA线从四点九四降至一点九九，柱状图持续为负但幅度从负三点四一收窄至负二点五二，空头动能逐步衰竭。复合指标信号偏向空头，空头占比高达百分之六十六点七，但整体胜率百分之七十六点六表明信号可靠性较高，空头信号值得重视。

威廉指标从负九十四点六大幅回升至负四十九点四，快速脱离超卖区域。ATR十四周期从十三点七六升至十五点一五后回落至十四点三七，波动率有所放大。超级趋势线维持在二千七百三十八美元上方，形成较强的短线压力。随机RSI从零值回升至二十三点三，底部抬升趋势明确。

三、市场情绪与基本面分析

以太坊当前面临的基本面环境较为复杂。积极因素方面，企业级以太坊积累持续增加，上周净增一万五千一百一十二枚ETH，企业持仓总量突破六百零一万枚，占流通供应量的约百分之四点九，形成了结构性的需求底部。美国证券交易委员会批准三倍杠杆以太坊期货ETF，为投资者提供了更多元的风险敞口选择。现货鲸鱼需求同样强劲，净流入二亿零七百五十万美元，其中大额订单贡献一亿七千九百二十万美元，推动价格从二千六百九十六美元反弹至二千七百零五美元。

然而风险因素同样突出。以太坊现货ETF持续遭遇赎回，上周净流出达十三万八千万美元，富达FETH领跌，与比特币ETF连续净流入形成鲜明对比，反映机构资金在两者之间的偏好分化。质押退出队列激增，待解锁的ETH接近八十万枚，主要源于验证者安全再平衡，形成较大的潜在抛压。此外，以太坊订单簿深度已下滑至比特币的百分之三十五至四十五，在市场下跌时波动性将被放大。

宏观面上，美国财政部撤回针对非托管钱包和混币服务的加密监控规则，被视为加密隐私领域的重大胜利，降低了去中心化金融和点对点交易的监管摩擦。CFTC正式将ETH列为数字商品，为其提供了更清晰的监管路径。综合来看，以太坊短线承压但中长期基本面支撑仍在，需密切关注质押退出节奏和ETF资金流向变化。

title: Criptomoedas em 2026: quais são os cenários para Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana e XRP?
subTitle:
O mercado de criptomoedas iniciou outubro de 2026 apresentando sinais de recuperação e renovando o interesse de investidores institucionais e do público em geral. Depois de um período marcado por elevada volatilidade, Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana e XRP voltaram ao centro das discussões sobre os próximos movimentos do mercado.
Entretanto, apesar dos sinais positivos, o momento ainda exige cautela. A recuperação dos preços não significa necessariamente que um novo ciclo de alta esteja confirmado. Fatores como política monetária dos Estados Unidos, comportamento dos juros, fluxo de recursos para ETFs e liquidez global poderão determinar a direção das criptomoedas nos próximos meses.

Bitcoin volta a ganhar força

O Bitcoin continua sendo o principal ativo do mercado de criptomoedas e, atualmente, apresenta uma estrutura mais sólida do que a maioria das altcoins.
No início de outubro de 2026, o BTC voltou a negociar próximo de US$ 86 mil, aproximando-se de uma região de resistência importante. A recuperação ocorre em um momento no qual os investidores voltaram a observar entradas relevantes nos ETFs de Bitcoin negociados nos Estados Unidos.
Os fluxos institucionais são especialmente importantes porque demonstram que a demanda pelo ativo não depende exclusivamente de investidores de varejo. A entrada de grandes volumes de capital por meio dos ETFs pode contribuir para sustentar o preço e aumentar a liquidez do mercado.
Para os próximos meses, alguns níveis merecem atenção.
Em um cenário positivo, a superação da região de US$ 87 mil–90 mil poderia abrir espaço para uma tentativa de avanço em direção aos US$ 100 mil. Caso o movimento ganhe força e as condições macroeconômicas permaneçam favoráveis, não seria impossível observar projeções ainda mais elevadas.
Por outro lado, uma perda consistente da região de US$ 80 mil poderia provocar uma correção mais profunda.
Portanto, o Bitcoin apresenta atualmente uma relação entre risco e potencial de valorização que parece mais favorável do que a de grande parte das altcoins.

Ethereum precisa recuperar o protagonismo

O Ethereum permanece como o segundo maior ativo do mercado, mas seu comportamento recente é diferente do Bitcoin.
Embora o ETH tenha recebido investimentos institucionais e continue sendo uma das principais plataformas de contratos inteligentes, seu desempenho ainda depende de uma retomada mais consistente da demanda.
Um dos fatores que podem contribuir para essa recuperação são as atualizações previstas para a rede Ethereum. Melhorias de escalabilidade, eficiência e capacidade de processamento podem aumentar a competitividade da plataforma no longo prazo.
Em um cenário positivo, uma recuperação acima de US$ 3 mil poderia fortalecer a estrutura do Ethereum e abrir espaço para regiões de US$ 3.500 e US$ 4 mil.
Entretanto, caso o mercado continue priorizando Bitcoin, o Ethereum poderá apresentar desempenho inferior durante parte desse ciclo.
Assim, o ETH continua sendo um ativo relevante, mas precisa demonstrar maior força relativa para confirmar uma nova fase de valorização.

Solana chama atenção pelo potencial de crescimento

Entre as principais altcoins, Solana aparece como um dos projetos que mais despertam interesse.

O ativo apresentou uma recuperação expressiva ao longo de 2026 e voltou para a região de US$ 120.

Parte desse interesse está relacionada ao crescimento do ecossistema da Solana, à utilização da rede e às expectativas relacionadas às suas próximas atualizações tecnológicas.
Outro fator importante é o interesse institucional.
Caso os investimentos em produtos financeiros relacionados à Solana continuem aumentando, o ativo poderá se beneficiar de uma entrada adicional de capital.
Em um cenário otimista, a região de US$ 150 poderia ser um primeiro objetivo, seguida por US$ 180 e US$ 200.
Porém, é importante lembrar que o potencial de valorização da SOL vem acompanhado de maior volatilidade. Uma correção do mercado poderia provocar quedas significativamente maiores na Solana do que no Bitcoin.

XRP permanece entre as criptomoedas mais observadas

O XRP também apresenta um cenário interessante.
Depois de uma forte recuperação durante 2026, o ativo permanece muito abaixo de sua máxima histórica, o que faz com que parte dos investidores enxergue potencial de valorização caso o mercado entre novamente em uma fase de forte expansão.
Além disso, o crescimento dos produtos financeiros relacionados ao XRP aumentou sua exposição junto ao mercado institucional.
Tecnicamente, regiões próximas de US$ 1,70 podem ser importantes. Uma superação consistente desse nível poderia fortalecer o movimento e levar o mercado a observar US$ 2,00, US$ 2,50 e, em um cenário extremamente otimista, novas tentativas de aproximação da máxima histórica.
Entretanto, assim como ocorre com Solana, o potencial de retorno é acompanhado por um risco consideravelmente maior.

O papel dos juros americanos

Um dos principais fatores que poderá determinar o comportamento das criptomoedas nos próximos meses não está necessariamente dentro do mercado cripto.
Trata-se da política monetária dos Estados Unidos.
As decisões do Federal Reserve, o banco central americano, influenciam diretamente a quantidade de liquidez disponível no sistema financeiro.
Quando os juros caem ou o mercado passa a acreditar em uma política monetária mais expansionista, ativos considerados de maior risco, como ações de tecnologia e criptomoedas, podem se beneficiar.
Por outro lado, juros elevados durante períodos prolongados tendem a aumentar a atratividade de investimentos de renda fixa e reduzir a disposição dos investidores para assumir riscos.
Por isso, acompanhar apenas o gráfico do Bitcoin pode não ser suficiente.
É necessário observar também inflação, mercado de trabalho americano, rendimento dos títulos do Tesouro dos Estados Unidos e expectativas para as próximas decisões do Federal Reserve.

ETFs podem ser uma das principais peças do mercado

Outra mudança estrutural importante no mercado de criptomoedas é o crescimento dos ETFs.
A existência de produtos regulamentados permite que investidores institucionais tenham exposição às criptomoedas sem necessariamente precisar comprar e armazenar os ativos diretamente.
Os fluxos de entrada e saída desses produtos passaram a funcionar como um importante indicador de demanda.
Se os ETFs continuarem apresentando entradas líquidas relevantes, isso poderá representar um sinal positivo para o Bitcoin e, posteriormente, para o mercado de altcoins.
Uma possível sequência seria:

Bitcoin → Ethereum → grandes altcoins → projetos de maior risco.

Esse processo é conhecido como rotação de capital.

Poderemos ter uma nova temporada de altcoins?

Essa é uma das principais perguntas para o mercado.
Caso o Bitcoin consiga romper resistências importantes e entrar em uma tendência de alta mais consistente, é possível que parte dos investidores passe a buscar ativos com maior potencial de valorização.
Nesse cenário, Ethereum, Solana, XRP e BNB poderiam receber maior atenção.
Entretanto, não significa que todas as criptomoedas irão subir.
Em ciclos anteriores, o mercado demonstrou que a liquidez tende a se concentrar inicialmente nos principais ativos. Somente depois, caso a confiança aumente, o capital pode migrar para projetos menores e mais especulativos.
Por esse motivo, uma eventual alta das altcoins deverá ser analisada de forma seletiva.

Três possíveis cenários para os próximos meses

Cenário otimista

Nesse cenário, a inflação americana permanece controlada, o Federal Reserve adota uma postura mais favorável à liquidez e os ETFs continuam recebendo recursos.
O Bitcoin rompe a região de US$ 90 mil e começa uma nova tentativa de alcançar US$ 100 mil ou mais.
Com a valorização do BTC, o capital começa a migrar para Ethereum, Solana, XRP e outras grandes altcoins.
Esse seria o cenário mais favorável para uma nova temporada de valorização das criptomoedas.

Cenário neutro

O mercado permanece em consolidação.
O Bitcoin oscila entre aproximadamente US$ 80 mil e US$ 90 mil enquanto os investidores aguardam novas informações sobre juros, inflação e crescimento econômico.
Nesse ambiente, algumas altcoins podem apresentar fortes movimentos individuais, mas o mercado como um todo não teria uma tendência definida.
Esse cenário poderia ser importante para acumulação gradual, principalmente para investidores de longo prazo.

Cenário pessimista

Nesse caso, a inflação volta a pressionar os bancos centrais, os juros permanecem elevados e os rendimentos dos títulos americanos aumentam.
Os investidores reduzem a exposição a ativos de risco.
O Bitcoin perde níveis importantes de suporte e volta para regiões próximas de US$ 70 mil–76 mil.
As altcoins sofreriam ainda mais.
Solana, XRP, Ethereum e outros ativos de maior risco poderiam apresentar quedas significativamente superiores às do Bitcoin.

Qual criptomoeda apresenta o melhor cenário?

Não existe uma resposta definitiva.
Cada ativo apresenta uma combinação diferente entre risco e potencial de retorno.
O Bitcoin continua sendo o ativo com maior maturidade e, consequentemente, tende a apresentar menor risco relativo dentro do mercado cripto.
O Ethereum oferece exposição ao maior ecossistema de contratos inteligentes e possui potencial de recuperação caso volte a atrair fluxos institucionais.
A Solana apresenta maior potencial de valorização, mas também maior volatilidade.
O XRP possui catalisadores próprios e pode apresentar forte desempenho caso o mercado volte a favorecer as grandes altcoins.
Já ativos como memecoins e criptomoedas de baixa capitalização podem oferecer retornos extraordinários em momentos de euforia, mas apresentam risco significativamente maior de perdas.

Conclusão

O mercado de criptomoedas entra em outubro de 2026 em uma posição bastante diferente daquela observada durante os períodos mais difíceis do ano.
Bitcoin voltou a apresentar força, os ETFs continuam desempenhando papel relevante e as expectativas relacionadas à política monetária americana podem favorecer ativos de risco.
Ao mesmo tempo, ainda existem riscos importantes.
A principal questão não é simplesmente descobrir se o Bitcoin irá subir ou cair, mas entender qual cenário está se formando e como o capital está se movimentando entre os diferentes ativos.
Para o investidor, acompanhar o preço isoladamente pode ser um erro.
Fluxos de ETFs, política monetária, inflação, juros, liquidez e comportamento das principais criptomoedas devem ser analisados conjuntamente.
Se o Bitcoin conseguir superar suas principais resistências e os fluxos institucionais permanecerem positivos, poderemos estar diante do início de uma nova fase de valorização.
Entretanto, caso o cenário macroeconômico se deteriore, a volatilidade poderá retornar rapidamente.
Por isso, mais do que tentar prever o futuro, o investidor deve estar preparado para diferentes cenários, controlar o risco e evitar decisões baseadas exclusivamente em euforia ou medo.#BTC #ETH #Xrp🔥🔥 $BCH

title: Se hizo pasar por cliente, perdió dinero a propósito y destapó a la red que lava el botín de Lazarus
subTitle:
Así un investigador infiltró el sindicato que movió más de 1.000 millones de dólares de hacks norcoreanos

El investigador blockchain #zachxbt publicó cómo se infiltró en un sindicato de crimen organizado chino que, según su investigación, ha lavado más de 1.000 millones de dólares procedentes de varios exploits atribuidos al grupo Lazarus, vinculado a Corea del Norte.

Tras el robo de 1.500 millones de dólares a Bybit en febrero de 2025 (atribuido al grupo TraderTraitor), detectó más de 15 cuentas en Telegram y Discord pidiendo ayuda con órdenes atadas a fondos robados. Se hizo pasar por cliente, contactó a un operador con el alias “Jimmy Green” y, el 6 de marzo de 2025, adelantó 349.700 USDC para cambiarlos por USDT en Tron.

La dirección que le dio Jimmy estaba financiada en gas por una wallet trazable a los fondos de Bybit y marcada en la lista negra pública del exploit.
Para ganar confianza completó varias operaciones más y aceptó perder un 5% en cada orden, sin garantía de que el intermediario no desapareciera con el dinero. Jimmy le adelantó movimientos (por ejemplo, que los fondos pasarían a Solana un día antes de que ocurriera), dijo que su equipo lavó la mayor parte de los 1.500 millones de Bybit y describió una operación con base en Hong Kong y China continental.

Una captura de un puente coincidió, por monto y hora, con una orden en THORChain. Tres direcciones de Solana revelaron un clúster de más de 12 millones de dólares del exploit de Bybit; Tether congeló después 442.000 USDT de ese grupo. El lavado usaba saltos de cadena ( #BTC , #ETH , #solana  y #Tron ) y un método nuevo con pools de Uniswap de tokens ilíquidos.
La misma fuente vinculó otro congelamiento de 332.000 USDC del exploit de Poloniex y 3 millones de dólares de fraude que ZachXBT trazó hasta una hot wallet de Huione Guarantee, servicio luego sancionado. El investigador entregó de inmediato los hallazgos a investigadores del sector privado y a las fuerzas del orden del caso, y por eso no pudo publicarlos antes. Desde 2022 dice haber contribuido a congelar más de 75 millones de dólares ligados a incidentes de Corea del Norte.

title: $ETH  UP 70% IN Q3… BUT LIQUIDITY IS THINNER
subTitle:
Ethereum just delivered a huge quarter.
$ETH gained ~70% in Q3, compared with roughly 42% for $BTC — its strongest Q3 performance in years.
But here’s the part traders shouldn't ignore:
📉 ETH's median daily market depth fell to just 35%–45% of Bitcoin's, versus 60%+ during the same period last year.
That means the rally happened while ETH's order books became relatively thinner.
And thinner liquidity can work both ways:
🚀 Less capital may be needed to push price higher.
⚠️ But large sell orders can also create sharper drops and more slippage.
ETH still has meaningful liquidity — around $13M–$14M within 0.15% of price — so this isn't a liquidity crisis.
For me, the key question now is:
Can ETH maintain its Q3 momentum while liquidity rebuilds?
Strong price ≠ strong market depth.

❌ Second stop-loss.

The Ethereum Foundation launches zkAPI to anonymize payments for AI services

The Ethereum Foundation and the Open Privacy Project have launched zkAPI, a system that lets users pay in advance for AI and other metered services without linking their billing identity to individual requests. The project launched on the Ethereum mainnet on October 1.

zkAPI uses zero-knowledge proofs and disposable API keys to separate payment identity from usage data. Users prepay for access and then interact with services through unique keys that have no persistent link to the payer’s identity.

The system addresses a specific privacy gap in metered services, such as AI APIs, where per-request billing typically creates a detailed record of user activity linked to payment credentials. The headline flags a caveat to the approach, although the source does not provide full details about what that limitation entails.

Treasury sanctions Hamas fundraising network that raised $2 million through fake charities

The United States Department of the Treasury has sanctioned a Hamas-linked fundraising network that raised more than $2 million through organizations posing as humanitarian charities, with hundreds of thousands of dollars moved via cryptocurrency.

The action highlights how cryptocurrency continues to appear in designated terrorist-financing operations alongside traditional financial channels. The Treasury’s move targets both the individuals and entities involved in the network, cutting them off from the U.S. financial system.

translatedData.content:
Seeing “the exit queue hit a new high for the year” doesn’t mean you should immediately assume ETH is about to get dumped. On-chain data can be misleading when you read the headline but not ask why the funds are moving.

Ethereum’s staking exit queue has surged recently: on September 29, it was only around 166,000 ETH; by October 2, it had briefly jumped to around 851,000 ETH $ETH . There are still around 786,000 ETH queued to exit, with a wait time of nearly 14 days—the longest since the start of 2026.

Those numbers do look alarming.

But I wouldn’t immediately interpret this as “851,000 ETH getting ready to be dumped.”

A large part of this increase came from MetaMask taking validators offline as a precaution following a security incident, involving Lido-related nodes. Lido has said that these ETH are expected to be gradually staked again, which doesn’t mean they’ll all flow to exchanges to be sold.

What’s more interesting is that nearly 1.5 million ETH are also waiting to enter staking, with a wait time of up to around 25 days.

So the picture right now is kind of surreal:
Some are lining up to exit, while even more funds are lining up to enter.

What I’d really watch isn’t how long the exit queue is, but where those ETH go after they leave.

If large amounts flow to exchanges, that’s real selling pressure. If they’re restaked or moved into long-term custody, this “exit wave” may just be a technical reshuffling.

Don’t panic just because the queue is getting longer.

On-chain, what matters most has never been “how much moved,” but “where it went afterward.”

content:
看到“退出队列创年内新高”，先别急着喊ETH要被砸。很多时候，链上数据最怕只看标题，不看钱为什么出来。

以太坊质押退出队列最近突然飙升：9月29日还只有约16.6万枚ETH，10月2日一度冲到约 85.1万枚$ETH ；目前仍有约78.6万枚ETH排队退出，等待时间接近14天，创下2026年以来最长水平。

数字确实吓人。

但这次我反而不会直接理解成“85万枚ETH准备砸盘”。

因为这波增长很大一部分来自MetaMask在安全事件后预防性下线验证者，涉及Lido相关节点。Lido已经表示，这部分ETH后续预计会逐步重新质押，并不等于全部流向交易所卖出。

更有意思的是，另一边还有接近 150万枚ETH正在排队进入质押，进入等待时间甚至长达约25天。

所以现在的画面其实挺魔幻：
有人排队出来，也有更多资金排队进去。

我真正会盯的，不是退出队列有多长，而是这些ETH出来以后去了哪里。

如果大量流入交易所，那才是真抛压；如果重新质押或者进入长期托管，那这次“退出潮”可能只是一次技术性搬家。

别看到队伍变长就慌。

链上最重要的从来不是“动了多少”，而是“动完去了哪里”。

ETH Surged 70% in Q3 — But Liquidity Is Falling 

Ethereum had an impressive Q3:
ETH jumped around 70% in Q3, significantly outperforming Bitcoin’s roughly 42% gain.

But here’s the interesting part:
While ETH rallied, its market liquidity actually became thinner.
According to CoinGecko, ETH’s median market depth during Q3 was only around 35%–45% of Bitcoin’s, compared with at least 60% during the same period last year.

So what does that mean?
👉 When prices rise, thinner liquidity can make moves happen faster.
👉 But when prices fall, volatility can also increase.

ETH still has around $13M–$14M of market depth within 0.15% of the current price, so it’s not accurate to say there is “no liquidity.”
The bigger question is:
Can fresh capital keep flowing into ETH and eventually deepen the market?

Q4 may be about more than just price.
ETH’s 70% Q3 rally was impressive — but thinner liquidity means bigger moves could be coming.

Bigger orders can swing price more than the chart alone suggests. Still tradeable (most exchanges hold $1M+ depth), just less cushioned than the rally makes it look.

This ETH drop has the same causes as Bitcoin’s.
First, that wick up top. On the 2nd, it climbed all the way from 2697 to 2777, looking like it was about to break out, then suddenly turned around and plunged, dipping below 2648. It took most of the day to go up, but only a few hours to come back down. A classic bull trap.
Second, Bitcoin was rejected at 87k. It was the third time in two weeks it had tested that level, and it failed to break through all three times. If the big guy can’t get higher, ETH can’t make its own move either.
Third, there was another incident near the Strait of Hormuz. An oil tanker was hit that day, the sixth such incident that week. Oil prices barely moved, but crypto trades 24/7, so the risk-off sentiment was priced in here first.
Fourth, a leverage-driven liquidation cascade. Long positions had piled up during the rally, and once the price broke down, liquidations amplified the drop.
Put all four together, and you get that long upper wick.
For the past three days, it’s been stuck between 2660 and 2730, and it hasn’t touched 2777 again.
It can’t push through the ceiling, but it can’t break through the floor either.
So I’m going to swing trade from here: buy near the bottom of the range, then flip short near the top and keep trading the range.
I’m not making a big directional bet until a clear trend emerges. #ETH  $ETH

It’s been a bumpy year. BTC fell below $90,000 in November 2025, hit a low of exactly $60,000 in February 2026, and tested $58,115 in June—about 54% below its peak, the deepest point of this cycle. It began to recover in August, reaching a high of around $87,400 on September 21. Since October began, several attempts to break above $87,000 have failed to hold. BTC has rebounded about 47% from its June low and would need to rise another roughly 47% to return to its previous high.

$ETH  also remains below last year’s high: it peaked at around $4,755 in October 2025 and is now trading at about $2,700. BNB peaked at $1,375 in October 2025 and is now around $782, down about 43%. In the previous three cycles, BTC’s maximum declines from its peak ranged from 77% to 85%, and it took 28 to 38 months to reach a new high. This cycle’s deepest decline has been about 54%, and it is currently in its 12th month.

BTC’s rebound has been losing steam over the past couple of days, and the market’s underlying momentum has already shifted to the other side. Long upper wicks keep forming as prices rally and then retreat, with heavy resistance overhead. I’m watching the four-hour structure. Every time the price probes higher, volume fails to follow; buying pressure gets thinner and thinner, while volume clearly picks up more on the pullbacks. What does this price-volume relationship tell us? It means sellers aren’t absent overhead—they’re simply more determined than buyers. The hourly chart keeps printing long upper wicks, with each high lower than the last. The rebound is being shaved down layer by layer. This isn’t consolidation before a move higher; it’s a slow grind downward.

Some people might ask, what if it prints another bullish candle? I’m not ruling out a rebound, but a rebound and a reversal are two different things. As long as the price can’t hold above the previous high, every push upward gives the bears a better entry. The price is currently trading just below the previous high. Resistance has been tested repeatedly, but there hasn’t been enough volume to break through. In this structure, a move down is clearly more likely than a move up. Now look at the risk-reward ratio. Resistance overhead is clear, and the stop-loss range is tight; if the price breaks below the lower end of the recent range, the downside potential is much greater than the modest rebound available above. Shorting here means risking little to potentially gain much more—a favorable setup.

I’m not chasing the short, and I’m not making random moves in the middle of the range. I’ll wait for the price to return near the resistance zone before considering an entry—that’s where the bears should step in. The weaker the rebound, the smoother the next pullback is likely to be. title: 三位宾大校友，看懂三代财富浪潮
subTitle:
财富不属于最努力的人，属于看懂时代的人
你敢相信吗？特朗普、马斯克、孙宇晨，居然全都是宾夕法尼亚大学沃顿相关的校友。
三人并非同班同学，却刚好代表三个时代截然不同的财富样本。
🏙️特朗普，1968年沃顿毕业，路径：房地产→资本→政治；
🚀马斯克，宾大双学位，物理+沃顿商科，路径：互联网→科技→AI航天；
₿孙宇晨，宾大校友，路径：互联网→区块链→数字资产。
很多人听过孙宇晨早年那套《财富自由革命之路》，财富自由，难道仅仅是拼命努力赚钱吗？
或许更关键的一点，是你能不能看见下一轮财富浪潮。
特朗普踩中房地产品牌崛起的时代红利；
马斯克押中互联网、新能源、航天与AI；
孙宇晨入局区块链、数字资产赛道。
所以很多人会感慨：真正的财富跃迁，往往不是单纯比别人更努力，而是更早进入全新的价值网络。
有意思的是，这三条独立的赛道，后来产生了现实交集。
2025年，孙宇晨参与特朗普家族加密项目World Liberty Financial，出席相关加密活动。
一条清晰的时间线浮现：
宾大 → 商业 → 科技 → 加密 → AI，走向全新的财富时代。
三位不同年代的宾大校友，三条完全不一样的道路，却都在追逐同一件事：时代变革带来的巨大机会。
这也是《财富自由革命之路》最值得深思的一句话：
财富，永远不只是属于最努力的人，而是持续流向看懂时代趋势、抓住时代变化的人。
但一定要理性看待：每一轮新兴浪潮里，都蕴藏巨大机遇，也藏着极高风险。浪潮不等于稳赚，看懂趋势，更要守住风险底线。#

translatedData.content:
When BTC is pulling back and forth above $85,000, what worries me most right now isn’t getting the direction wrong—it’s overlooking execution slippage.

Before placing an order, many people look at only two things: where the candlesticks are and whether they’re comfortable with the trade. But what really determines whether a trade goes smoothly is often hidden in the finer details: has the gap between the best bid and ask suddenly widened? Is order-book depth only stacked at the top? Are quotes refreshing a beat too slowly? Have fees and slippage together already exceeded the risk buffer you expected?

This is especially true right after the market has spiked and pulled back. The order book may still look busy, but the depth you can actually trade against may already have thinned out. You think you’re targeting a price, when really, your order is testing the current execution environment.

My habit is to do a quick execution check before placing an order:
Is the spread normal?
Can the available depth absorb this order?
Does the trigger condition use the same price source I’m watching?
How far is the estimated fill price from the current quote?
Are the fees, slippage, and wait time worth it?

Judging direction is half of trading; order quality is the other half. The biggest value for me in an execution-focused perspective like PerpEX isn’t being told what to buy. It’s the reminder that the same asset can have completely different execution quality depending on the route.

BTC在8.5万上方拉扯时，我现在最怕的不是方向错，而是成交偏差被自己忽略。

很多人下单前只看两个东西：K线位置、自己能不能接受这一单。但真正决定这单舒服不舒服的，往往藏在更细的地方：买一卖一的距离有没有突然变宽，挂单厚度是不是只堆在表层，报价刷新有没有慢半拍，手续费和滑点加起来是否已经超过预期风险缓冲。

尤其是行情刚冲高回落之后，盘口看起来还有量，但能吃的深度可能已经变薄。你以为自己是在抓一个价格，其实是在用一笔订单测试当前订单环境。

我的习惯是，下单前先做一次很快的执行体检：
价差是不是正常；
深度能不能承接这笔订单；
触发条件是否和自己看的价格源一致；
预估成交价和眼前报价差多少；
费用、滑点、等待时间加起来值不值得。

方向判断是交易的一半，订单质量是另一半。PerpEX这类执行比较视角，对我最大的价值不是告诉我买什么，而是提醒我：同一个资产，不同路径的成交质量可能完全不是一回事。

BTC surged to around 87,000 yesterday before pulling back, and was still hovering near 85,800 in early trading today. At levels like this, it’s easy to fall for a particular illusion: the candlestick chart looks fine, and so does the trading environment.

But I’m more concerned about something else: Has the quote book thinned out? Have spreads widened? Is the actual execution of the same-size order starting to drift?

When reviewing trades, many people focus only on whether they got the direction right, overlooking order quality. After the market shifts from a rally and pullback to a narrow-range tug-of-war, changes in the order book often warn you before the price does: the order may look unchanged, but execution costs have already shifted.

My rule of thumb is that the more the market is in a “direction still undecided” phase, the more important it is to compare trading conditions first. Depth, spreads, trigger conditions, fees, and execution slippage—even small differences can add up to real losses when you’re trading frequently or using a larger notional size.

The value of an execution-focused comparison view like PerpEX isn’t that it tells you whether prices will rise or fall. It’s that it prompts you to ask one more question before placing an order: Is this route still worth taking right now?

📰 Mining Rig Fire Sale: $150 Million in Hashrate Suddenly Disappears—What Is BTC So Afraid Of?

Mining difficulty plunged in the first half of the year, and miners dumped Bitcoin mining equipment worth around $150 million in hashrate. This wasn’t due to technological obsolescence so much as a reluctant retreat driven by “AI grabbing all the power.” Most of the retired hashrate came from high-energy-cost areas in the western U.S. Miners are now heading to places like Ohio, where coal-fired power dominates. This poses a risk to the stability of Bitcoin network hashrate and could also affect market sentiment.

Why does this news matter?
The root cause is that electricity prices in states like California and Nevada have soared above $200 per megawatt-hour. Miners are being forced to choose between slashing prices to unsustainable levels or leaving. Ohio charges just $15 per megawatt-hour, but its grid frequently fails; Texas has cheap electricity, but the weather is a problem. This means Bitcoin’s hashrate center of gravity is undergoing a once-in-a-century migration. Recent regulatory pressure (such as the SEC’s hashrate report) may have accelerated the process, as miners begin using the logic that “hashrate is sovereignty” to push back against regulation.

Market impact
In the short term, the loss of hashrate could intensify selling pressure on Bitcoin. These miners will need at least 2–3 months to set up mining operations again, and during that time they may liquidate their Bitcoin collateral. In theory, BTC has support at $85,038, but the shift of capital from the western U.S. to Ohio means hashrate may become even more fragmented. ETH is relatively less affected, but mining costs are also rising in Europe, which could trigger similar capital outflows.

Trading approach
💡 Continued migration of hashrate could weigh on BTC sentiment, but if inflows into ETFs exceed expectations, $80K is a key support level. If regulators do take action (for example, banning the relocation of coal-powered hashrate), this assessment no longer applies.

上半年挖矿难度暴降，矿工们扔了价值约1.5亿美元的比特币算力设备。这不是技术淘汰，更像是被"AI抢电"逼退的无奈之举。这些被淘汰的算力主要来自美西能源昂贵地区，现在矿工们正往俄亥俄等煤电为主的地方跑。这对比特币网络算力稳定是个隐患，更可能传导到币价情绪。

这件事根本原因在于美国加州、内华达等州的电价飙升到200美元/兆瓦时以上。矿工被迫选择自杀式降价或离开。俄亥俄州只需15美元/兆瓦时，但电网频出故障；德州电价低但天气是问题。这意味着比特币算力重心正在经历世纪大迁徙。近期监管压力（如SEC的算力报告）可能加速了这个进程，矿工们开始用"算力即主权"的逻辑对抗监管。

📰 Philippine Court Seizes 25 Crypto Wallets and 86 Bank Accounts: Why Is the Regulator Suddenly Taking Action?

A Philippine court has suddenly seized 25 cryptocurrency wallets and 86 bank accounts during an investigation into flood control projects. The funds involved could amount to millions of dollars. This shows that the global fight against corruption is beginning to target crypto assets, creating new obstacles for laundering money through digital currencies.

Why does this news matter?
The root of the issue is that crypto assets have long been seen as a safe haven for moving illicit funds. The Philippine flood control projects involved public funds, and the court’s seizure has directly exposed the myth that “crypto assets are difficult to trace.” As institutional investors continue to increase their allocations, regulators are finally starting to address the compliance vacuum surrounding digital assets. This is in line with the SEC’s recent push to strengthen oversight of project fundraising.

Market impact
The direct impact on BTC/ETH prices is limited. ETH is currently at $2.6937, still within its 24-hour trading range, but this signals that there will be more cases of regulatory crackdowns on crypto assets. The implications for the market are: 1) Funds will continue seeking regulatory havens; 2) Exchanges will need to strengthen their KYC processes; 3) Mainstream assets like Bitcoin will gradually become regulatory test cases. A similar historical event was the U.S. closure of some Bitfinex accounts in 2017, but the scale and intensity far exceed those of this case.

💡 I believe this marks an evolution in regulators’ understanding of crypto assets. In the short term, it may trigger risk-averse sentiment among some investors, but whether bullish sentiment can persist depends on BTC holding the key $83,000 level. This assessment would no longer hold if larger-scale seizures occur in the future or compliance pressure on major exchanges surges.

菲律宾法院在洪水治理项目调查中突然查封25个加密货币钱包和86个银行账户，涉案金额可能高达数百万美元。这显示全球反腐败斗争开始将加密资产纳入打击范围，对资金如何通过数字货币进行洗白形成新障碍。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这件事的根本原因在于加密资产曾长期被视为腐败转移的避风港。菲律宾洪灾项目涉及公共资金，法院此次查封直接撕开了"加密资产难以追踪"的假象。在机构投资者持续增加配置的背景下，监管层终于开始解决数字资产在合规性上的真空问题。这与SEC近期加强对项目融资监管的思路一脉相承。

对市场的影响
对BTC/ETH价格的直接影响有限。目前ETH 2.6937美元仍处于24小时波动区间内，但意味着未来监管打击加密资产的案例会越来越多。对市场格局的影响在于：1) 资金会继续寻找合规洼地；2) 交易所需要加强KYC流程；3) 像比特币这样的主流资产会逐渐成为监管试点。历史上类似事件有2017年美国关闭Bitfinex部分账户，但规模和力度都远超此次。

💡 我认为这标志着监管对加密资产的认知升级，短期可能引发部分资金规避风险情绪，但BTC守住83000美元关键位置则看多情绪能否延续。如果未来出现更大规模类似查封行动，或主要交易所合规压力暴增，这个判断作废。

【判断附带失效条件】如果美国等主要经济体也同步采取强力措施，那么这个区域性案例对全球市场的警示效应会减弱。

title: The Impact of Global Issues on Crypto Prices
subTitle:
Crypto prices are known for being highly volatile, and global issues are one of the main reasons. Because the market runs 24/7 and trades across borders, crypto reacts quickly to news from anywhere in the world.
1. Monetary policy and interest rates
Decisions by major central banks, especially the Fed, strongly affect the market. When interest rates rise, investors tend to move toward safer assets like bonds, so risk assets such as crypto often come under pressure. Conversely, low rates and abundant liquidity usually boost interest in crypto.
2. Inflation and economic conditions
High inflation leads some people to see Bitcoin as "digital gold" that protects the value of their assets. In practice, though, this correlation isn't always consistent. When a recession looms, investors often sell risk assets, including crypto, to hold cash.
3. Geopolitics and conflict
Wars, economic sanctions, and tensions between countries can trigger sharp volatility. On one hand, crypto is sometimes used to move funds across borders. On the other, global uncertainty usually pushes the market down in the short term due to panic selling.
4. Government regulation
Bans, restrictions, or new taxes can quickly push prices down. Conversely, clear regulation and approval of products like crypto ETFs can raise institutional confidence and attract large inflows.
5. Market sentiment and social media
News, statements from well-known figures, and social media trends often trigger euphoria (FOMO) or fear (FUD). Because so many retail investors are involved, sentiment can move prices more than fundamentals do.
6. Internal industry events
Exchange hacks, crypto company bankruptcies, and technology failures also have wide impact. Events like these can spread across the whole market and lower investor confidence.
Conclusion
Crypto prices don't move in isolation; they are closely tied to global economic conditions, politics, and market psychology. Investors should monitor these issues, manage risk, and never invest more than they can afford to lose. This article is for informational purposes only and is not financial advice.

Amy Street, former head of ROVE Growth, revealed that she left over unpaid wages and missing token records. According to Binance Square, she emphasized that she had not received a complete account of her token allocations for nearly a year, and her salary reimbursements remained unresolved. This directly raises questions about the credibility of ROVE founder Jason Desimone. As a star company in the crypto social space, ROVE is facing serious scrutiny over its finances and governance transparency.

Why does this news matter?
At the heart of this controversy is a trust deficit. In the crypto industry, paying wages and distributing tokens are basic commitments, but ROVE’s actions expose the financial gaps that can emerge as some projects grow rapidly. This is not an isolated case: the recent Lido compensation scandal and Solend governance issues point to the same underlying problem—some projects may neglect compliance and transparency while pursuing aggressive early expansion. For ROVE, this means stepping into the “payroll fraud” minefield at a time of increasingly stringent regulation.

Market impact
The impact on prices is likely limited, as ROVE is relatively small and current BTC/ETH prices ($84,989.12 / $2,695.57) are mainly driven by broader market conditions. However, this incident will intensify scrutiny of small and mid-sized projects. Investors will ask: could you or I be next to get caught up in a scandal? This could concentrate capital further in leading projects, as institutions place greater importance on endorsements from law firms and audit reports when screening projects. Historically, similar incidents have typically triggered risk-off selling in related assets within 72 hours of becoming public, but the broader market trend soon overshadows it.

Trading approach
Our current assessment is that ROVE will not directly drag down the BTC/ETH trend, but the incident will reinforce the market’s risk aversion. If ROVE quickly resolves its unpaid wage issues and improves transparency, this controversy may prove to be just short-term noise. But if regulators intervene or the founder’s credibility collapses, it could trigger a ripple effect across the crypto social sector. If BTC holds the key level of $84,989.12 and ETH holds $2,695.57, broader market sentiment is still likely to remain choppy but relatively strong. If prices break below these levels, this assessment no longer applies.

📰 Why Is Bitcoin’s Volatility Decreasing?

Crypto analyst Darkfost says that Bitcoin’s price fluctuations around its power-law trend line have gradually narrowed over the past decade, with market-cycle volatility becoming more contained. According to ChainCatcher, he said the model’s oscillation indicator peaked at +169 in 2018 and fell to +102 in 2025, while the standard deviation of daily changes also dropped from 4.81 to 2.47, a decrease of about 49%. Darkfost also noted that the model’s current oscillation indicator is +34.5, with Bitcoin trading around $84,700.

Why does this news matter?
Darkfost’s analysis suggests that Bitcoin’s price behavior may be becoming more predictable. The sharp fluctuations in the Bitcoin market over the past decade may be giving way to more stable patterns, potentially due to institutional investment, a maturing market, or the saturation of volatility trading strategies. Amid regulatory cycles and macroeconomic uncertainty, this convergence in volatility could actually strengthen market resilience.

Market impact
In the short term, converging Bitcoin volatility could attract investors with a more stable risk appetite, but it would not change the long-term bull-and-bear market structure. This means that Bitcoin could see fewer rapid surges or crashes during extreme market conditions like those in 2018. Historical comparisons show that U.S. stock market volatility also declined significantly after the 2008 financial crisis, followed by a structural shift toward longer bull markets and shorter bear markets.

Trading outlook
I think Bitcoin’s declining volatility is favorable for long-term holders, but it could create more range-bound trading opportunities in the short term. If $84K breaks below $82K, this view that volatility is converging is invalidated. What do you think? This view would also be invalidated if the Federal Reserve suddenly turns hawkish.

【ETH’s price action looks harmless, but it’s quietly nasty】

Bitcoin ETFs have seen net inflows for three straight weeks, while Ethereum ETFs have seen outflows of 138 million.

Money is voting with its feet, and the message is clear: when things are uncertain, get out first.

Think this is a problem with ETH’s fundamentals? No—it’s money looking for certainty. In a bull market, people chase imagination; in a choppy market, they chase whatever falls the least. Bitcoin’s market share is 58.7%. What does that tell you? Money is piling into the place with the strongest consensus. No matter how compelling ETH’s story sounds, when things are uncertain, it isn’t the first choice.

That 3x fixed-loss product—those who know, know. Who is it made for? People who think they can control their position size, but actually can’t. The very existence of this thing is a signal: the market is handing retail traders a magnifying glass so they can lose faster and with greater certainty.

Where am I stuck right now? 2,791 above, 2,627 below, just wobbling around in this range. It’s been 7 days, and we’re up less than 1%. Frustrating to watch. But look at it another way: this frustration is the answer in itself. If the market were really going to pick a direction, it wouldn’t still be grinding away at this level.

I’ve been waiting since 2017 for an opportunity that “nobody dares to take.” Now… it’s still not quite there.

What’s your mindset right now? With BTC sucking liquidity out of ETH, are you following the money or following the story this time?

对市场的影响

According to CoinDesk, 5,419 long-dormant bitcoins were awakened in September, with a total value of $457 million. Although that was below August’s record level, it was still far above July’s figure. These BTC were moved to new addresses in 93 transactions. Why did these “time capsules” suddenly awaken, and what does it mean?

August was a record month for activity among dormant bitcoins, but in September, large amounts of long-unused BTC began moving again. These BTC may belong to early investors, whales, or project reserves. Their sudden use could be influenced by market sentiment, specific events, or capital rotation.

In-Depth Analysis

Why does this news matter?
These transfers reveal changing dynamics in the pool of funds. On the one hand, they show that market liquidity has not completely dried up and that some capital is still moving according to its own rhythm. On the other hand, the behavior of long-term holders may signal changing expectations among different types of investors—perhaps approval of the current price, or a reassessment of future opportunities. title: 🚨 Ethereum Just Ripped +70%... But Here's the Part Nobody Is Talking About 👀🔥
subTitle:
Ethereum had a monster Q3. 🚀 While the whole market was watching Bitcoin, ETH quietly stepped up and **outperformed BTC by a wide margin**:

🟢 **$ETH:** +70%
🟠 **$BTC:** +42%

A gap of nearly 28 percentage points is no small win. 💪 ETH bulls are celebrating, and the timeline is full of green candles. 📈

But experienced traders know one rule: **price is only half the story.** ⚠️

## 📉 The Hidden Problem: Liquidity Is Getting Thinner

While ETH was pumping hard, **market liquidity was shrinking.**

Here is what the data shows:

- 📉 ETH's median market depth has dropped to just **35–45% of BTC's**
- 📊 Last year, that number was **60%+**

That is a big structural shift. 😳

## 🤔 What Is Market Depth, and Why Does It Matter?

Market depth shows how many buy and sell orders are sitting in the order book at different price levels. 📚

- 🟢 **Deep market:** large orders get absorbed easily, and price moves smoothly.
- 🔴 **Thin market:** even a moderate order can push price sharply.

When depth falls, the market has less cushion. A single big buyer or seller can move price much more than before. 💥

And this works in **BOTH directions**:

- 🚀 A large buy order can send ETH pumping faster than expected.
- 🩸 A large sell order can trigger sudden drops, wicks, and liquidation cascades.

## 🔥 The Math Traders Should Remember

> **70% UP + LIQUIDITY DOWN = VOLATILITY ALERT** 🚨

Strong rallies often make traders feel safe. But when a rally happens on thinning liquidity, the market can become **more fragile, not more stable.** 🧊

## ⚖️ Two Possible Scenarios

### 🟢 Scenario 1: Another Explosive Move
If demand stays strong and big buyers keep pushing into thin books, ETH could see sharp upside moves. 🚀 Thin liquidity can amplify bullish momentum, and breakouts can accelerate quickly.

### 🔴 Scenario 2: A Brutal Liquidity-Driven Shakeout
If sentiment flips or large holders start selling, the same thin books can turn a small dip into a deep flush. 🩸 Stop-losses get hit, leveraged longs get liquidated, and price can drop faster than most traders expect.

Nobody knows which way it will go. What we do know is that **volatility risk is rising.** ⚡

## 🛡️ How Smart Traders Can Prepare

1. 🎯 **Use proper position sizing.** Don't go all-in just because ETH is strong.
2. 🛑 **Always set stop-losses.** Sudden wicks are more common in thin markets.
3. ⚠️ **Be careful with high leverage.** Low depth plus high leverage is a dangerous mix.
4. 📊 **Watch the order book and volume.** Price alone doesn't tell the whole story.
5. 🧠 **Stay flexible.** Be ready for both breakouts and fakeouts.

## 🏁 Final Thoughts

Ethereum's +70% Q3 run is impressive, and it clearly beat Bitcoin's +42%. 🏆 But the decline in market depth is a reminder that **strong price action does not always mean a strong market structure.**

Is ETH setting up for another explosive leg up... or a liquidity-driven shakeout? 🤯

One thing is clear: **ETH traders can't afford to look away right now.** 👀🔥

Why does this news matter?

📰 How can Cerebras use a 5nm wafer-scale design to sidestep the AI chip shortage? How does it work?

AI chip company Cerebras has come up with a new design that uses the more readily available 5nm process instead of today’s scarce 3nm process to build massive AI chips. Put simply, it has found a new approach that temporarily sidesteps the global semiconductor capacity crunch. That’s good news for companies looking to get into AI but unable to buy chips.

Why does this news matter?
The fundamental reason this news matters is that the AI chip shortage isn’t temporary—it’s structural. Major manufacturers like TSMC and Samsung are doing everything they can to ramp up production, but shifting capacity from traditional business areas like smartphones to AI chips takes at least a year. Cerebras’ approach gets around this bottleneck, meaning the AI industry could have another supplier to turn to. This isn’t directly related to the market’s broader cyclical concerns (such as the Fed slowing the pace of rate hikes), but it does give companies urgently needing AI computing power—such as those training large language models—some breathing room.

Impact on the market
For BTC and ETH, the question is whether this is a case of good news already being priced in or a rotation into new catalysts. In the short term, the market may feel that AI chip supplies aren’t as severely constrained, which could boost sentiment. Over the longer term, though, this is just one company’s solution. Overall demand for AI chips is still growing explosively, so the shortage won’t disappear overnight. There aren’t many similar precedents, but the dot-com bubble of 2000 offers a point of comparison: a technology was hyped as revolutionary, only for its promise to turn out to be a more limited bright spot.

💡 This means the tight supply of AI chips may simply be taking a different form. On the other hand, users are increasingly reluctant to expose their purchase history to platforms. zkAPI uses zero-knowledge proofs to solve this technical challenge. It’s like mathematical magic: service providers get paid, while users retain their right to anonymity. This is different from past approaches that either revealed everything or revealed nothing, and marks an important advance in privacy computing.

title: ETH反弹到2715附近：低位放量后，突破还需要什么确认？
subTitle:
ETH反弹到2715附近：低位放量后，突破还需要什么确认？

我的判断先说在前面：ETH 短线从 2,680 附近反弹，4 小时低位成交明显放大，说明这里发生了较大换手；但小时线仍未有效突破 2,720—2,740 压力带，合约持仓和资金费率也没有给出强烈的趋势共振。当前更适合观察反弹质量，不宜把一次低位反抽直接当成新一轮上涨确认。

一、行情快照：反弹存在，但价格还在区间内

截至北京时间 2026 年 10 月 6 日 07:36，币安 ETH/USDT 现货约报 2,714.63 USDT，滚动 24 小时下跌 0.46%，区间为 2,679.63—2,738.00 USDT，现货 24 小时成交额约 7.35 亿 USDT。

这里的成交额是买卖成交的累计金额，不等于净流入；价格和成交额均为取数时点快照，会继续变化。

最近一根完整 4 小时 K 线收在约 2,709.25，最低下探至 2,679.63；最近一根完整小时 K 线收在约 2,716.00。当前价格仍低于 2,738 附近的短线高点，暂时只能定义为回踩后的反弹，不能提前写成突破。

二、不同周期的信号并不完全一致

日线方面，最近一根完整日线收在约 2,726.94，高于日线 MA7 约 2,691.70 和 MA25 约 2,617.93。大周期修复结构暂时没有被破坏，但最近 20 根完整日线的高点约 2,807.34，距离当前仍有明显压力，站在均线上方不等于已经进入单边上涨。

4 小时方面，最近一根完整 K 线从 2,679.63 反弹收至 2,709.25，高于 4 小时 MA25 约 2,701.69，但仍低于 MA7 约 2,713.73。这个位置说明短线有所修复，却还没有脱离压力与支撑之间的震荡结构。

小时方面，最近完整小时收在 2,716，略高于小时 MA25 约 2,715.97，但仍没有连续收盘站稳 2,720 上方。小时最近 20 根 K 线高点约 2,734.55，低点约 2,679.63，可先把这段区间视为观察范围，而不是预测目标。

三、4 小时放量，究竟说明了什么？

最近完整 4 小时 K 线成交额约 2.98 亿 USDT，是此前 20 根完整 4 小时 K 线平均成交额的约 3.46 倍。价格在 2,680 附近出现低点后回升，说明该区域的交易和换手显著增加。

但放量本身不能区分主动买入、止损卖出、空头平仓和多空换手。它可以证明市场在这个位置更活跃，不能单独证明买方已经重新掌控趋势。更有说服力的确认，需要看到后续 K 线在 2,720—2,740 上方收盘，并且回踩时没有快速跌回区间。

反过来看，最近完整小时成交额约 919.93 万 USDT，仅为此前 20 根完整小时平均值的约 27.6%。时段差异会影响小时成交，不能单凭一根缩量 K 线判断必然下跌；但它至少说明，当前反弹还没有持续放量配合。

四、合约数据：没有明显拥挤，也没有明确方向

币安 ETHUSDT 永续合约的公开持仓历史显示，最近约 24 小时的未平仓量按 ETH 数量从约 227.89 万增加至约 228.40 万，增幅约 0.22%。同期持仓名义价值反而约下降 0.34%，主要受到价格变化影响。

OI 小幅增加，只能说明未平仓合约略有扩张。每份合约都有多空双方，单靠 OI 无法判断哪一方更主动，也不能据此断言资金正在集中做多。

最近一轮已结算资金费率约为 +0.002986%，当前接口的最新资金费率约为 +0.002080%。正值意味着结算时多头向空头支付资金费，但这个水平并不高，暂时看不到类似极端拥挤的证据。资金费率会随市场变化，不能当作固定收益或单独的买卖信号。

五、接下来我会看哪些价位？

第一，2,695—2,705：短线回踩观察区。这里接近近期 4 小时 MA25 和前一轮交易位置。如果回踩后能守住并重新收复 2,720，反弹结构会更完整；若 4 小时收盘跌回该区间下方，低位放量就更像换手而不是趋势启动。

第二，2,720—2,740：反弹确认区。需要看到小时或 4 小时收盘逐步站上，并在回踩时守住。盘中刺穿 2,740、随后收回区间，不能算有效突破。

第三，2,680 附近：本轮回踩低点。若后续 4 小时有效跌破，且反抽无法收回，短线反弹判断失效，下一步应重新寻找下方承接，不应继续沿用“低位放量就是看涨”的结论。

更上方的 2,777—2,807 是前期高点观察区。在 2,740 没有完成收盘确认之前，直接讨论挑战 2,800，属于把条件推演当成事实。

六、结论：先等价格和量能同时确认

偏强情景是：ETH 守住 2,695—2,705，随后以连续收盘收复 2,720—2,740，回踩不失守，且小时成交逐步放大。这样才说明低位换手可能转化为更有持续性的反弹。

震荡情景是：价格继续在 2,680—2,740 之间反复，4 小时有量但小时跟进不足。此时更应把上涨和下跌都看作区间波动，不把局部放量解读为方向确定。

偏弱情景是：4 小时收盘跌破 2,680，反抽无法收回，同时下跌成交增加。那将削弱大周期修复仍在延续的判断。

当前 ETH 的关键，不是有没有反弹，而是反弹能否在压力位上方留下已收盘的证据。低位放量值得关注，但在收盘、回踩和后续量能共同确认前，我仍把它定义为反弹观察，而不是趋势突破。

content:
一、以太坊市场走势分析：多空均衡中寻找突破方向

截至北京时间十月六日凌晨，以太坊报价二千七百一十五点八八美元，过去二十四小时小幅下跌百分之零点四八。从近期一小时K线来看，价格在二千七百零六至二千七百二十二美元之间窄幅波动，整体呈现温和震荡上行态势。最近五根K线显示，价格从二千七百一十点五六逐步攀升至二千七百一十八点六四的高点，虽偶有回调但底部逐步抬高，短期多头格局初现。成交量方面，最近一小时成交额约九百二十万美元，整体维持在较为活跃的水平。

二、技术指标综合解读

均线系统方面，七日均线报二千七百一十二点九五美元，价格运行在其上方，短期趋势偏多。二十五日均线位于二千七百一十五点四八美元，当前价格几乎与之持平，表明中期方向尚不明朗。九十九日均线在二千七百零二点四二美元，为多头提供了可靠的底部支撑。值得注意的是，七日均线上穿九十九日均线，形成短期金叉结构。

MACD指标出现积极变化，柱状图从负一点八七逐步收窄并成功翻正至零点二五，这是短期多头信号的重要确认。MACD线从负零点三零上升至一点三九，信号线从一点五七回落至一点一四，两线趋于收敛，若MACD线继续上穿信号线将强化看多预期。RSI六周期指标报六十点零，处于中性偏多区间，既未超买也未超卖，上行空间充裕。

KDJ指标表现强势，K线升至七十四点二，D线位于六十二点六，J值高达九十七点三，三线呈多头排列。布林带方面，价格在中轨二千七百一十二点九三上方运行，上轨二千七百三十点构成短期压力位，下轨二千六百九十五点七八提供支撑，带宽持续收窄暗示即将迎来方向性突破。

三、市场情绪与基本面分析

利好因素方面，监管机构批准了首只三倍杠杆以太坊ETF产品，拓展了机构参与以太坊的衍生品渠道。企业买盘同样积极，Bitmine公司增持一万五千一百一十二枚以太坊，总持仓达到六百零二万枚，展现出对以太坊长期价值的坚定看好。此外，单笔一亿七千九百万美元的大额买单在二千六百九十六美元附近成功托底，推动价格反弹至二千七百一十八美元。

但风险同样显著。以太坊质押提款队列激增至约八十万枚，提款延迟达十四天，形成了较大的潜在供给压力。现货以太坊ETF持续遭遇赎回，上周净流出超过五万二千枚以太坊，反映出机构资金对以太坊的偏好明显弱于比特币。此外，一位休眠的ICO早期参与者向交易所转入了一万三千三百三十枚以太坊，价值约三千六百四十万美元，增加了短期抛压。综合因子模型显示，十五个信号因子中七个看多、七个看空、一个中性，复合指标发出看多信号，胜率约百分之八十五，整体偏乐观但仍需关注资金流向变化。

title: 10月6日行情报告：BTC守住8.5万后反弹，趋势突破还差什么？
subTitle:
截至 2026 年 10 月 6 日 06:38，北京时间，加密市场更接近“大周期修复延续，短线震荡分化”。BTC 和 ETH 的已收盘日线、周线仍高于近期均线，但上方压力尚未有效突破，小时级别的反弹也缺少持续放量确认。

这份报告主要分析 BTC、ETH 及币安活跃合约样本。价格与 K 线使用币安现货 USDT 交易对；持仓、资金费率及涨跌分布使用币安 USDT 永续，两个市场的口径分开列示。

1、市场快照：主流币回落，局部热点活跃

以下为取数时的现货价格及滚动 24 小时涨跌幅：
BTC：85,892.01 USDT，-0.66%。
ETH：2,715.36 USDT，-0.47%。
BNB：788.59 USDT，-0.93%。
SOL：121.03 USDT，-0.75%。
XRP：1.5097 USDT，-0.66%。
DOGE：0.09572 USDT，-1.02%。

BTC 近 24 小时波动区间为 84,972—86,999，现货成交额约 14.39 亿 USDT；ETH 区间为 2,679.63—2,739.50，现货成交额约 7.52 亿 USDT。成交额不等于净流入。

在币安当前可交易、近 24 小时成交额不少于 1,000 万 USDT 的 146 个 USDT 永续合约样本中，79 个上涨、67 个下跌，涨跌幅中位数约 +0.41%。

样本里，RLC 上涨约 101.55%，NIL 上涨约 24.21%，FLUID 上涨约 19.05%；另一边，LYN 下跌约 17.74%，STRK 下跌约 10.67%。

我的判断：行情有局部活跃机会，但分化很大。涨幅榜上的极端表现，不能外推为普遍上涨，更不能直接当作买入理由。上述统计是经过成交额筛选的单一交易所样本，不代表全市场。

2、BTC：先看 8.6 万能否站稳，再看前高突破

大周期仍偏修复。最近已收盘日线收在 86,530，高于日线 MA7 约 84,496、MA25 约 81,752；最近已收盘周线同样收在 86,530，高于周线 MA7 约 80,683。

不过，上两根完整周线的高点分别约 87,396 和 87,220。价格接近这一带，仍需要证明能持续突破前高，不能只根据均线位置就认定进入新一轮单边上涨。

4 小时结构更谨慎：最近已收盘 K 线收在 85,724，低于该周期 MA7 约 85,929，高于 MA25 约 85,286，处在短期压力与下方支撑之间。

小时线从 84,972 低点反弹，最新完整小时收在 85,949，但仍略低于小时 MA25 约 86,005。该小时现货成交额只有此前 20 根完整小时平均值的约 43%，反弹暂未得到明显放量支持。单根量能会受时段影响，还需要后续连续观察。

我关注的价位是：
• 85,000—85,300：下方第一观察区，对应本轮低点和 4 小时均线附近。
• 86,000 附近：短线强弱分界。小时收盘收复并回踩守住，反弹结构才更完整。
• 86,700—87,400：上方压力带，涵盖近期小时高点及周线前高。
• 若 85,000 附近失守且反抽无法收回，再观察 84,450—84,750 的近期低点区域。

这些是依据本次 K 线推导的观察区域，不是必到目标或确定支撑。

3、ETH：2,700 附近有承接，上方仍要过 2,740—2,750

ETH 最近已收盘日线收在 2,726.94，高于日线 MA7 约 2,691.70 和 MA25 约 2,617.93；周线也高于 MA7，说明大周期修复尚未被破坏。

最近完整 4 小时 K 线从最低 2,679.63 回升，收在 2,709.25，略高于 MA25 约 2,701.69，但仍低于 MA7 约 2,713.73。这根 K 线现货成交额约为此前 20 根平均值的 3.46 倍，说明低位附近交易明显放大；仅凭量能，不能区分其中有多少是主动承接、抛售或短线换手。

最新完整小时收在 2,718，回到小时 MA25 约 2,715.42 上方，但这一小时成交额仅为此前 20 根平均值的约 20%。因此，前一阶段的大量换手与随后的小幅反弹，需要分开理解。

关键区域：
• 2,695—2,705：短线支撑观察区。
• 2,680 附近：本轮回踩低点。若收盘跌破且无法收回，反弹判断转弱。
• 2,740—2,750：第一压力区，接近近期多次高点。
• 2,777—2,807：更高一级压力区，对应此前日线、周线高点。

在 2,740—2,750 没有被有效收复前，我更倾向于把当前走势视为区间内修复。

4、合约数据：BTC 持仓收缩，资金费率降温

10 月 5 日 06:00 至 10 月 6 日 06:00，币安 BTC 永续持仓数量下降约 3.21%，ETH 基本持平，下降约 0.03%。这里比较的是合约对应的代币数量，避免把币价变化误算为新增或退出的仓位。

北京时间 10 月 6 日 00:00，最近一轮已结算资金费率为：
BTC：-0.001541%。
ETH：+0.002986%。

相较前两次结算，两者费率均有所下降。我的解读是：BTC 这段调整伴随未平仓合约减少，追涨拥挤程度有所缓和；但 OI 下降不能单独证明空头回补、多头撤退或某一方正在主导。负资金费率也不是自动看涨信号。

5、接下来如何判断行情走向？

偏强情景：BTC 先收复 86,000，再以有量能配合的 4 小时收盘突破 86,700—87,400；ETH 同步站上 2,740—2,750，并在回踩时守住。若上涨合约比例也持续扩大，市场转强的证据更充分。

震荡情景：BTC 在约 85,000—87,000、ETH 在约 2,680—2,750 之间反复，热点快速轮动，突破后缺少跟进。这种环境里，对单个热点的追涨判断应更谨慎。

偏弱情景：BTC 跌破 85,000、ETH 跌破 2,680，且后续反抽无法收回，并伴随下跌成交量增加。届时应下调对短线修复的判断，重新寻找支撑，而不是沿用旧的看多结论。

截至取数时，北京时间 06:00 开始的小时线、04:00 开始的 4 小时线，以及 10 月 5 日 08:00 开始的 UTC 日线都尚未收盘。本文均线和突破判断只使用完整 K 线；滚动 24 小时涨跌幅与自然日涨跌幅不是同一口径。

当前最值得等待的是主流币收盘突破、量能跟进和上涨范围扩大同时出现。日线、周线修复提供了继续观察的理由；上方前高未破、短线量能不足和热点分化，则是暂时保留判断的理由。
